ai_summary: Shankara Buildpro Limited has announced a 1:5 stock split, sub-dividing each Rs. 10 face value equity share into five shares of Rs. 2 face value each. This shareholder-approved action aims to increase the number of outstanding shares and likely improve market liquidity by making shares more accessible to a broader investor base. The record date for determining eligible shareholders for this split is Thursday, October 08, 2026, with no immediate red flags identified regarding this corporate action.
